parallel.implementation: Implemented Soot IR utilities, CHA call graph, copy propagation, dead-code elimination, FlowDroid-style taint analysis, StubDroid summaries, runner wiring, local requirements, tests, and commits.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Assembled the final tree through parent-owned commits and requirement_patches, with cleanup of accidental bytecode and a final clean workspace before closure.
parallel.verification: Ran py_compile, unit tests, and bash run.sh locally; those checks passed but did not assert the official Soot experiment key names.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official Soot tests failed because emitted metric keys were generic aggregate names instead of the exact expected experiment names.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same three modules, standalone execution, deterministic runner, KEY: VALUE line requirement, and git patch workflow; it also found the requirements directory absent.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept the entire workflow in a single serial trajectory with no child activity, no spawn calls, and one owner for implementation, verification, patching, and closure.
serial.implementation: Implemented comparable Soot, FlowDroid, and StubDroid layers plus tests, runner changes, requirement patches, and commits in a single-threaded path.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Committed each requirement patch and left a clean workspace, with the final deliverable assembled by the same agent that wrote the implementation.
serial.verification: Ran module checks, unit tests, and bash run.sh locally; the checks reported success but used SOOT-prefixed output names that the official tests did not accept.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official Soot tests failed because emitted metric keys used SOOT_* names instead of TOTAL_JIMPLE_STMTS and the other expected keys.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized the requested Soot, FlowDroid, StubDroid modules, standalone execution, run.sh orchestration, and experiment-line output contract, while noting the referenced requirements directory was absent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same three-module stack, deterministic runner, and experiment-line output obligation, with the same absent requirements directory caveat.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-scope difference is evidenced; both relied on the prompt and visible benchmark corpus after the requirements directory was missing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Used parallel mode with four spawn calls and three child-agent paths, but the parent retained final implementation and commit ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial protocol validation shows no child activity, no child paths, and no spawn calls; one agent owned the whole implementation path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed survey work across child agents while serial kept all task work in one trajectory; final delivery ownership remained with the parent in both.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent observed that the prompt-referenced requirements directory was absent and created local requirement mirrors from the prompt while continuing implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run also observed the missing requirements directory and treated the visible harness slugs and benchmarks as the operative contract.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both faced the same context gap; there is no child brief or handoff evidence showing that parallel lost a known evaluator contract at a coordination boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Implemented the layers and Soot metrics but emitted generic names such as BENCHMARKS_TOTAL, CALL_EDGES_TOTAL, and DEAD_STATEMENTS_REMOVED_TOTAL.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Implemented comparable layers and Soot metrics but emitted SOOT-prefixed names such as SOOT_STATEMENTS and SOOT_CALL_GRAPH_EDGES.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementation difference is metric naming style; neither used the exact official Soot experiment keys.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child-agent activity occurred, but the final implementation path shows the parent proceeded through verification and closure after taking over the work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to join; the single trajectory moved directly from implementation to verification and closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had extra child lifecycle events, but no completed child implementation was abandoned in a way that changed the delivered solution.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent assembled and committed all three requirements in the shared workspace after local verification and cleaned accidental bytecode in the final commit.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent committed the three requirement patches and kept the final tree clean without concurrent workspace writers.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state collision or overwrite is evidenced; the final issue was the chosen output-key contract, not competing edits.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Local tests and run.sh passed in the trajectory, but the official Soot test suite failed because the expected experiment keys were missing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Local tests and run.sh also passed before closure, but the official Soot test suite failed for the same missing expected keys.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both accepted local runner output that was not evaluator-aligned for Soot key names; the official post-test failures are matching.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used more tool calls and child activity but finished within the official timeout and produced a final summary claiming all three requirements implemented.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used fewer tool calls, also finished within the official timeout, and produced a final summary claiming all three requirements implemented.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Budget profile differed, but neither run timed out; both closed with the same unrecognized Soot experiment-key defect.

outcome_analysis.explanation: This pair is not discordant: both official status records completed evaluation and report solution_passed=false. Both failures are the same Soot experiment-output contract failure, with the official post-test reporting the same missing expected keys in both modes.
parallel_contributors: Parallel added survey child activity, waits, and interruptions, but the final failure is traced to parent-authored output names rather than a realized coordination consequence.
serial_contributors: Serial avoided child coordination entirely, but still selected evaluator-incompatible Soot metric names and therefore failed the same official tests.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel emitted generic aggregate names such as CALL_EDGES_TOTAL; serial emitted SOOT-prefixed names such as SOOT_CALL_GRAPH_EDGES. Neither matched the official expected Soot keys.
evaluator_effects: The hidden official Soot tests enforced exact experiment key names that neither local verification path checked.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both modes failed for the same evaluator-visible Soot output-key mismatch
